C0329.title: Ningbo Jiangbei Dismantles a Full-Chain "Virtual Number Factory"
C0329.summary: Between March and June 2025, defendants Zhou, Xu, and others obtained unverified virtual mobile numbers from upstream number dealers. Using high daily pay part-time job lures, they tricked job seekers into providing identity information and facial recognition, then used these materials without the job seekers knowledge to bulk-register virtual numbers and app accounts. The accounts were sold at marked prices to upstream number dealers and, after multiple resales, ultimately flowed to overseas fraud gangs. In three months, illegal proceeds exceeded 400,000 yuan and related fraud losses reached more than 15 million yuan.
